reviews.title: ANC is incredible
reviews.body: The active noise cancellation blocked out the entire subway ride. Superior low-frequency cancellation, I couldn't hear the engine at all.

reviews.title: Best noise cancelling I've owned
reviews.body: Noise cancellation is excellent on flights. The quiet is amazing and the isolation is superb for open offices.

reviews.title: Great ANC, good sound
reviews.body: Noise cancellation is effective and the sound is clear with solid bass. Very happy overall.

reviews.title: Multipoint is broken
reviews.body: Frequent audio stuttering when switching from laptop to phone during calls. The multipoint handoff disconnects constantly, so frustrating.

reviews.title: Bluetooth keeps dropping
reviews.body: The multipoint pairing stutters and drops every time I switch devices. Connection is unreliable and disconnects mid-call.

reviews.title: Handoff disconnects
reviews.body: Switching between my tablet and phone causes a disconnect and I have to re-pair. Multipoint handoff is buggy.

reviews.title: Multipoint hit or miss
reviews.body: When it works multipoint is nice but it stutters when switching sources. Bluetooth latency is noticeable on video.

reviews.title: Battery lasts forever
reviews.body: Battery playtime is fantastic, I get well over a week of commuting on one charge. USB-C fast charge is great.

reviews.title: Solid battery
reviews.body: The 40 hour battery claim holds up, excellent power management and long playtime.

reviews.title: Battery drains in standby
reviews.body: Battery drains overnight even when off. Poor battery standby, dies fast if you forget to power down. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Ears get hot
reviews.body: The cushions trap heat and my ears get sweaty after an hour. Comfortable padding otherwise but the heat is annoying.

reviews.title: Comfortable but warm
reviews.body: Memory foam cushions are comfortable at first but get warm and sweaty on long sessions. Wish the padding was breathable.

reviews.title: Too tight
reviews.body: The clamp force is too tight and gives me a headache and pressure after 30 minutes. Uncomfortable for long use.

reviews.title: Very comfortable
reviews.body: Super comfortable fit, the headband and cushions feel premium and the fit is perfect for my head.

reviews.title: Amazing sound
reviews.body: Sound quality is superb, crisp treble and rich bass. The audio clarity is excellent and the soundstage is wide.

reviews.title: Great audio
reviews.body: Really nice balanced sound, clear mids and clean bass. Hi-res audio sounds great with my player.

reviews.title: App crashes constantly
reviews.body: The companion EQ app crashes every time I open the equalizer. App is buggy and freezes on my phone, unusable.

reviews.title: Firmware update bricked settings
reviews.body: After the firmware update the app crashes and my EQ settings were wiped. Software is a mess and the update broke pairing.

reviews.title: Buggy app
reviews.body: App crashing when I try to change settings. The software needs a lot of work, very frustrating.

reviews.title: Mic sounds muffled
reviews.body: Callers say my voice is muffled and they can't hear me well. The microphone quality on calls is poor.

reviews.title: Calls are okay
reviews.body: Call quality is average, the mic is a bit muffled in noisy places but fine in a quiet room.

reviews.title: Hinge creaks
reviews.body: There is an annoying creak from the hinge when I adjust the headband. Build feels a little flimsy there.

reviews.title: Good but scratches
reviews.body: Nice headphones but the matte finish scratches easily and shows fingerprints. Minor cosmetic gripe.

reviews.title: Premium build
reviews.body: Feels sturdy and durable, quality materials all around. Solid build with no rattles.

reviews.title: Arrived damaged by courier
reviews.body: The courier threw the box and it arrived damaged. Terrible delivery experience, packaging was crushed.

reviews.title: Late shipping
reviews.body: Shipping was two weeks late and the seller never responded. Nothing to do with the product, just slow delivery.

reviews.title: Noise cancelling + comfy
reviews.body: The ANC is amazing and they are comfortable too. Blocks subway noise and the fit is great for long commutes.

reviews.title: Happy overall
reviews.body: Great noise cancellation, good battery and nice sound. A couple of app bugs but I recommend them.
